passages.text: After this I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude in heaven, shouting: “Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God!
passages.sermon:
John is the speaker.
John heard a loud sound.
The sound came from a great crowd.
The crowd was in heaven.
The crowd was shouting.
They shouted, “Hallelujah!”
They said, “Salvation belongs to our God.”
They said, “Glory belongs to our God.”
They said, “Power belongs to our God.”
passages.original: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἤκουσα ὡς φωνὴν μεγάλην ὄχλου πολλοῦ ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ λεγόντων Ἁλληλουϊά ἡ σωτηρία καὶ ἡ δόξα καὶ ἡ δύναμις τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν

passages.text: For His judgments are true and just. He has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her immorality. He has avenged the blood of His servants that was poured out by her hand.”
passages.sermon:
God judges all people.
God’s judgments are always true.
God’s judgments are always just.
God judged the great prostitute.
The great prostitute corrupted the earth.
She used her immorality to corrupt the earth.
God avenged the blood of His servants.
She killed God’s servants.
God punished her for killing them.
passages.original: ὅτι ἀληθιναὶ καὶ δίκαιαι αἱ κρίσεις αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἔκρινεν τὴν πόρνην τὴν μεγάλην ἥτις ἔφθειρεν τὴν γῆν ἐν τῇ πορνείᾳ αὐτῆς καὶ ἐξεδίκησεν τὸ αἷμα τῶν δούλων αὐτοῦ ἐκ χειρὸς αὐτῆς

passages.text: And a second time they called out: “Hallelujah! Her smoke rises forever and ever.”
passages.sermon:
A great multitude stood in heaven.
They called out a second time.
They shouted, “Hallelujah!”
Smoke from the great prostitute rises forever and ever.
passages.original: Καὶ δεύτερον εἴρηκαν Ἁλληλουϊά καὶ ὁ καπνὸς αὐτῆς ἀναβαίνει εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων

passages.text: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying: “Amen, Hallelujah!”
passages.sermon:
Twenty-four elders stood before God.
Four living creatures stood with them.
God sat on His throne.
The elders and the living creatures fell down.
They worshiped God.
They said, “Amen.”
They said, “Hallelujah!”
passages.original: Καὶ ἔπεσαν οἱ πρεσβύτεροι οἱ εἴκοσι τέσσαρες καὶ τὰ τέσσαρα ζῷα καὶ προσεκύνησαν τῷ Θεῷ τῷ καθημένῳ ἐπὶ τῷ θρόνῳ λέγοντες Ἀμήν Ἁλληλουϊά

passages.text: Then a voice came from the throne, saying: “Praise our God, all you who serve Him, and those who fear Him, small and great alike!”
passages.sermon:
A voice spoke from the throne.
The voice gave a command.
The voice said, “Praise our God.”
All who serve God must praise Him.
All who fear God must praise Him.
This includes everyone, both small and great.
passages.original: Καὶ φωνὴ ἀπὸ τοῦ θρόνου ἐξῆλθεν λέγουσα Αἰνεῖτε τῷ Θεῷ ἡμῶν πάντες οἱ δοῦλοι αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ φοβούμενοι αὐτόν οἱ μικροὶ καὶ οἱ μεγάλοι

passages.text: And I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude, like the rushing of many waters, and like a mighty rumbling of thunder, crying out: “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God the Almighty reigns.
passages.sermon:
John heard a sound.
The sound was very loud.
The sound was like a great crowd.
The sound was like rushing water.
The sound was like strong thunder.
The people cried out together.
They said, “Hallelujah!”
They said, “The Lord our God reigns.”
The Lord is Almighty.
passages.original: Καὶ ἤκουσα ὡς φωνὴν ὄχλου πολλοῦ καὶ ὡς φωνὴν ὑδάτων πολλῶν καὶ ὡς φωνὴν βροντῶν ἰσχυρῶν λεγόντων Ἁλληλουϊά ὅτι ἐβασίλευσεν Κύριος ὁ Θεός ἡμῶν ὁ Παντοκράτωρ

passages.text: Let us rejoice and be glad and give Him the glory. For the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His bride has made herself ready.
passages.sermon:
God is the Lord Almighty.
The Lamb is Jesus Christ.
The Lamb will be married.
His bride is ready.
Let us rejoice.
Let us be glad.
Let us give God the glory.
The marriage of the Lamb has come.
The bride has prepared herself.
passages.original: χαίρωμεν καὶ ἀγαλλιῶμεν καὶ δώσομεν τὴν δόξαν αὐτῷ ὅτι ἦλθεν ὁ γάμος τοῦ Ἀρνίου καὶ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ ἡτοίμασεν ἑαυτήν

passages.text: She was given clothing of fine linen, bright and pure.” For the fine linen she wears is the righteous acts of the saints.
passages.sermon:
The bride of the Lamb received clothing.
She was given fine linen.
The linen was bright.
The linen was pure.
This fine linen means the righteous acts of the saints.
passages.original: καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτῇ ἵνα περιβάληται βύσσινον λαμπρὸν καθαρόν Τὸ γὰρ βύσσινον τὰ δικαιώματα τῶν ἁγίων ἐστίν

passages.text: Then the angel told me to write, “Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb.” And he said to me, “These are the true words of God.”
passages.sermon:
An angel spoke to me.
The angel told me to write these words.
He said, “Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb.”
He also said, “These are the true words of God.”
passages.original: Καὶ λέγει μοι Γράψον Μακάριοι οἱ εἰς τὸ δεῖπνον τοῦ γάμου τοῦ Ἀρνίου κεκλημένοι καὶ λέγει μοι Οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι ἀληθινοὶ τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰσιν

passages.text: So I fell at his feet to worship him. But he told me, “Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers who rely on the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.”
passages.sermon:
John saw an angel.
John fell at the angel’s feet.
John wanted to worship the angel.
The angel spoke to John.
The angel said, “Do not do that.”
The angel said, “I am a fellow servant with you.”
The angel said, “I am also a servant with your brothers.”
Your brothers have the testimony of Jesus.
Worship God.
The testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.
passages.original: Καὶ ἔπεσα ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ προσκυνῆσαι αὐτῷ καὶ λέγει μοι Ὅρα μή σύνδουλός σού εἰμι καὶ τῶν ἀδελφῶν σου τῶν ἐχόντων τὴν μαρτυρίαν Ἰησοῦ τῷ Θεῷ προσκύνησον ἡ γὰρ μαρτυρία Ἰησοῦ ἐστιν τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς προφητείας

passages.text: Then I saw heaven standing open, and there before me was a white horse. And its rider is called Faithful and True. With righteousness He judges and wages war.
passages.sermon:
John saw heaven open.
He saw a white horse.
A rider sat on the white horse.
People call this rider Faithful and True.
This rider judges with righteousness.
This rider makes war with righteousness.
passages.original: Καὶ εἶδον τὸν οὐρανὸν ἠνεῳγμένον καὶ ἰδοὺ ἵππος λευκός καὶ ὁ καθήμενος ἐπ’ αὐτὸν καλούμενος Πιστὸς καὶ Ἀληθινός καὶ ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ κρίνει καὶ πολεμεῖ

passages.text: He has eyes like blazing fire, and many royal crowns on His head. He has a name written on Him that only He Himself knows.
passages.sermon:
The rider is called Faithful and True.
He sits on a white horse.
He judges and makes war with righteousness.
His eyes are like blazing fire.
He wears many royal crowns on His head.
He has a name written on Him.
Only He Himself knows this name.
passages.original: οἱ δὲ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ ὡς φλὸξ πυρός καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ διαδήματα πολλά ἔχων ὄνομα γεγραμμένον ὃ οὐδεὶς οἶδεν εἰ μὴ αὐτός

passages.text: He is dressed in a robe dipped in blood, and His name is The Word of God.
passages.sermon:
Jesus rides a white horse from heaven.
He wears a robe.
His robe is dipped in blood.
His name is The Word of God.
passages.original: καὶ περιβεβλημένος ἱμάτιον βεβαμμένον αἵματι καὶ κέκληται τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ὁ Λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ

passages.text: The armies of heaven, dressed in fine linen, white and pure, follow Him on white horses.
passages.sermon:
The armies of heaven follow Him.
They ride on white horses.
They wear fine linen.
Their linen is white and pure.
passages.original: Καὶ τὰ στρατεύματα τὰ ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ ἐφ’ ἵπποις λευκοῖς ἐνδεδυμένοι βύσσινον λευκὸν καθαρόν

passages.text: And from His mouth proceeds a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations, and He will rule them with an iron scepter. He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is the One called the Word of God.
A sharp sword comes out of His mouth.
He uses this sword to strike down the nations.
He rules the nations with an iron scepter.
He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.
passages.original: καὶ ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ ἐκπορεύεται ῥομφαία ὀξεῖα ἵνα ἐν αὐτῇ πατάξῃ τὰ ἔθνη καὶ αὐτὸς ποιμανεῖ αὐτοὺς ἐν ῥάβδῳ σιδηρᾷ καὶ αὐτὸς πατεῖ τὴν ληνὸν τοῦ οἴνου τοῦ θυμοῦ τῆς ὀργῆς τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ Παντοκράτορος

passages.text: And He has a name written on His robe and on His thigh: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.
passages.sermon:
Jesus rides a white horse.
He leads the armies of heaven.
He wears a robe.
He has a name written on His robe.
He also has a name written on His thigh.
The name is KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.
passages.original: καὶ ἔχει ἐπὶ τὸ ἱμάτιον καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν μηρὸν αὐτοῦ ὄνομα γεγραμμένον ΒΑΣΙΛΕΥΣ ΒΑΣΙΛΕΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΚΥΡΙΟΣ ΚΥΡΙΩΝ

passages.text: Then I saw an angel standing in the sun, and he cried out in a loud voice to all the birds flying overhead, “Come, gather together for the great supper of God, so that you may eat the flesh of kings and commanders and mighty men, of horses and riders, of everyone slave and free, small and great.”
passages.sermon:
I saw an angel.
The angel stood in the sun.
The angel cried out with a loud voice.
He spoke to all the birds flying overhead.
He said, “Come, gather for the great supper of God.
Eat the flesh of kings.
Eat the flesh of commanders.
Eat the flesh of mighty men.
Eat the flesh of horses.
Eat the flesh of those who ride the horses.
Eat the flesh of all people.
Eat the flesh of slaves and free people.
Eat the flesh of small and great people.”
passages.original: Καὶ εἶδον ἕνα ἄγγελον ἑστῶτα ἐν τῷ ἡλίῳ καὶ ἔκραξεν ἐν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ λέγων πᾶσιν τοῖς ὀρνέοις τοῖς πετομένοις ἐν μεσουρανήματι Δεῦτε συνάχθητε εἰς τὸ δεῖπνον τὸ μέγα τοῦ Θεοῦ ἵνα φάγητε σάρκας βασιλέων καὶ σάρκας χιλιάρχων καὶ σάρκας ἰσχυρῶν καὶ σάρκας ἵππων καὶ τῶν καθημένων ἐπ’ αὐτῶν καὶ σάρκας πάντων ἐλευθέρων τε καὶ δούλων καὶ μικρῶν καὶ μεγάλων

passages.text: Then I saw the beast and the kings of the earth with their armies assembled to wage war against the One seated on the horse, and against His army.
passages.sermon:
John saw the beast.
John saw the kings of the earth.
John saw their armies.
The beast, the kings, and their armies gathered together.
They gathered to fight.
They wanted to make war against the One seated on the horse.
They wanted to make war against His army.
The One seated on the horse is Jesus Christ.
Jesus Christ is called KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.
passages.original: Καὶ εἶδον τὸ θηρίον καὶ τοὺς βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς καὶ τὰ στρατεύματα αὐτῶν συνηγμένα ποιῆσαι τὸν πόλεμον μετὰ τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ ἵππου καὶ μετὰ τοῦ στρατεύματος αὐτοῦ

passages.text: But the beast was captured along with the false prophet, who on its behalf had performed signs deceiving those who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image. Both the beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into the fiery lake of burning sulfur.
passages.sermon:
The beast was captured.
The false prophet was captured with the beast.
The false prophet had performed signs for the beast.
The false prophet used these signs to deceive people.
He deceived those who received the mark of the beast.
He deceived those who worshiped the image of the beast.
The beast and the false prophet were both thrown alive into the lake of fire.
This lake burns with sulfur.
passages.original: καὶ ἐπιάσθη τὸ θηρίον καὶ μετ’ αὐτοῦ ὁ ψευδοπροφήτης ὁ ποιήσας τὰ σημεῖα ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ἐν οἷς ἐπλάνησεν τοὺς λαβόντας τὸ χάραγμα τοῦ θηρίου καὶ τοὺς προσκυνοῦντας τῇ εἰκόνι αὐτοῦ ζῶντες ἐβλήθησαν οἱ δύο εἰς τὴν λίμνην τοῦ πυρὸς τῆς καιομένης ἐν θείῳ

passages.text: And the rest were killed with the sword that proceeded from the mouth of the One seated on the horse. And all the birds gorged themselves on their flesh.
passages.sermon:
The One seated on the horse held great authority and power.
A sword came out from His mouth.
The rest of the people who opposed Him were killed by this sword.
All the birds ate their flesh until they were full.
passages.original: καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ ἀπεκτάνθησαν ἐν τῇ ῥομφαίᾳ τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ ἵππου τῇ ἐξελθούσῃ ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ Καὶ πάντα τὰ ὄρνεα ἐχορτάσθησαν ἐκ τῶν σαρκῶν αὐτῶν
